g.text: Annotated gene body length, log10 axis
Gene length is associated with both mCH and MeCP2 binding, so it is
shown for every set that the mCH panels compare.
Wilcoxon Neuronal vs Other genes: p < 2.2e-16
Wilcoxon Synapse and axon vs Other genes: p < 2.2e-16
Wilcoxon Neuronal + MeCP2 up vs Neuronal only: p < 2.2e-16
Wilcoxon Neuronal + MeCP2 up vs MeCP2 up only: p = 3.51e-05
